svg.aria-label: Engagements: Strategy to algorithm: A visual or discretionary strategy turned into exact rules, filters and adaptive indicators, delivered as Pine Script v6, MQL5 or cAlgo C#, with the same logic across platforms; Trading platform build: A custom research or execution platform: data pipeline, backtesting, FIX or broker connectivity, risk controls, delivered as CLI and/or GUI; Full-stack product: A website or web application end to end: frontend, backend API, database, authentication, encryption and deployment; Validation and hardening: Walk-forward, CPCV and Monte Carlo testing, overfitting detection and performance work for existing systems
